players.bio: Agustín Ezequiel Cardozo (born 30 May 1997) is an Argentine footballer who plays for Lanús.
Carlos Roberto Izquierdoz (born 3 November 1988) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a defender for Boca Juniors.

Eduardo Antonio Salvio (born 13 July 1990) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Boca Juniors and the Argentina national team as a right winger. Salvio started his career with Lanús in 2008.

Felipe Peña Biafore (born 20 April 2001) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Lanús, on loan from River Plate. Peña is a product of River Plate's youth academy, having joined in 2012. On 14 February 2020, he signed his first professional contract with his childhood club.

Franco Nahuel Watson (born 25 July 2002) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for the Argentine Primera División club Lanús. Club career Watson is a youth product of Instituto, having joined at the age of 7 and working up their youth categories. He started training with their senior team in 2019.

Gonzalo Germán Pérez Corbalán (born 4 January 2001) is a Uruguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender for Lanús. Career A youth academy graduate of Liverpool Montevideo, Pérez signed his first professional with the club ahead of 2020 season. He made his professional debut on 8 August 2020 in a 1–1 draw against Rentistas.

José María Canale Domínguez (born 20 July 1996) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine Primera División side Lanús and the Paraguay national team. Canale debuted for Libertad on 28 May 2015 in a 3–0 win against San Lorenzo in the Paraguayan Primera División. On 29 July 2021, he moved to Argentina to join Newell's Old Boys on loan.
Juan Edgardo Ramírez (born 25 May 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Lanús, on loan from Boca Juniors.

Lucas Agustín Besozzi (born 22 January 2003) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Grêmio Football Porto-Alegrense, on loan from Lanús. Career Besozzi came through the youth ranks at Lanús.
Damián Marcelino Moreno (born 25 June 1994) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Brasileiro Série A club Coritiba on loan from Atlanta United.
Matías Ignacio Sepúlveda Méndez (born 12 March 1999) is a Chilean football player who plays as a midfielder for Universidad de Chile in the Chilean Primera División.
Mauricio Andrés Pellegrino Luna (Latin American Spanish: ; born 5 October 1971) is an Argentine former professional footballer who played as a centre-back, currently a manager.

Nahuel Hernán Losada (born 17 April 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Lanús. Career He was born on 17 April 1993 in Berisso, in the Province of Buenos Aires. He made the lower divisions in the Estudiantes de La Plata. With no place in the Estudiantes team, he was loaned to Unión de Mar del Plata for the whole of the 2015 season.
Ramiro Ángel Carrera (born 24 October 1993) is an Argentine footballer who plays as a midfielder for Lanús.

Tomás Ezequiel Guidara (born 13 March 1996) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Vélez Sarsfield. Club career Guidara's career started with Belgrano at the age of 16 in the club's youth system.

Walter Ariel Bou (born 25 August 1993) is an Argentine professional footballer who plays for Lanús. Career Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata Bou started his youth career at Boca Juniors, but was released on a free transfer before debuting with the first team. He was signed by Gimnasia, debuted for them in the Argentine Primera División on 23 August 2014, in a 2–1 defeat against Rosario Central.
